* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps (YAML pipelines, Azure Repos, Azure Artifacts, service connections, environments, and approval gates) for data pipelines, ML models, and application services deployed to GCP.
* Provision and manage GCP infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) executed through Azure Pipelines, covering GKE, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Vertex AI, Composer, and networking/IAM.
